name: max_health
title: player.max_health
lead: Their health now, 0 to `max_health`; nil where the game version has no damage rules. Writable: set outright, no flash; 0 is a death; a number above `max_health` stops there. The most health they can have: 20 unless a pack set it; nil where the game version has no damage rules. Writable, 1 to 1024; nil gives the game's own back. A lower maximum takes `health` down to it. It lasts for the session. Every Java client draws its hearts; Bedrock draws none.

usedIn.quote: player.health          -- their health now, 0 to player.max_health; nil where the version has no damage rules
player.max_health      -- the most health they can have: 20 unless a pack set it; nil for the same reason
